content:
kelly: Hey team — new hire trying to embed a Grafana panel in Notion and getting a 403. I can view the panel directly in Grafana but the iframe shows forbidden. Anyone run into SSO + embed issues? cc @maria

devex-bot: Quick docs: https://grafana.internal/docs/embed (check SSO, X-Frame-Options, and signed embeds). Common causes: server header blocking, or the embed token is user-scoped. :robot_face:

ross: Did you try opening the iframe src directly (paste into a new tab)? Embeds sometimes use cookies or headers that don't travel into iframes.

kelly: yep — opened it and got 403. Response headers look like this:

```
HTTP/2 403
x-frame-options: SAMEORIGIN
content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8
set-cookie: grafana_sess=...; Path=/; HttpOnly
```

kelly: so it looks like X-Frame-Options is the culprit. We use SSO (Okta) — could that be rewriting headers?

maria: That header will block embedding. By default we keep allow_embedding=false for security. Okta shouldn't rewrite X-Frame-Options normally, it's a Grafana config: `allow_embedding = false` in grafana.ini.

maria: Two safe paths: enable allow_embedding for the specific org/folder + use a signed embed token/service account, or keep it off and generate screenshots via the render API for static docs.

tj: We have a docs embed flow (signed URLs) that grants view-only access without interactive SSO. Less risky than opening embedding cluster-wide.

kelly: New hire needs interactive embed (they want to click legend toggles) so static render won't cut it. Is the signed embed interactive?

maria: Signed embeds can be interactive if you generate a proper signed session token and set the right permissions. Steps I'll take:
1) enable `allow_embedding = true` for the `docs` org only (we can scope via nginx route)
2) create service account `docs-embed-sa` with Viewer scoped to the dashboards folder
3) issue a signed embed token and hand it to the docs team

maria: Example curl to test (replace $TOKEN):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  'https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/panel?orgId=5&panelId=2'
```

ross: If you enable allow_embedding, please also ensure `Content-Security-Policy` and `X-Frame-Options` are set only for the docs path. We shouldn't regress security for other orgs.

maria: Agreed. I'll do a narrow nginx rule and a grafana.ini toggle scoped by URL. I'll open an infra change and post the PR here.

kelly: amazing — any ETA? the new hire starts in ~20m and wants the Notion page updated asap.

maria: I'll enable the nginx rule now and create the SA. If I run into permission gating from Vault/KMS I'll DM @kelly. Otherwise I'll post the signed URL in a private channel. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tj: I'll add a one-liner to the onboarding notes describing the signed-embed option so PMs know how to request it.

ross: filing a small docs PR too — will link to this thread. :memo: 

kelly: thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
